payload.contentHtml:
Mr Panda
求推荐哪家tts 最具性价比，开源或闭源、付费或免费都可以？
性价比只的是既真实好用价格又跟不要钱一样。

热门回复

@Krisp ♥ 859 · 💬 0

Can't follow that YouTube video because of the accent? One click fixes it. Free Chrome extension from Krisp.

@Investor Stats ™ ♥ 213 · 💬 0

If you're losing money in markets, it might be the website or app you open every day.

Most of these are marketing gimmicks encouraging imaginary lines and indicators. The market does not care about your lines.

Use a platform that encourages clarity. Get a FREE Finviz trial now

@Martin Tonev ♥ 146 · 💬 0

Most people use AI to write code.
Few use AI to plan the whole product.

@李东bbsky ♥ 30 · 💬 1

最推荐注册一个阿里百炼账号，它里面有3个语音模型，CosyVoice、QwenTTS和MiniMax。
最贵的要属MiniMax，效果最好也最贵，尤其是克隆声音，和真人最接近。
其他两个模型也非常推荐，能够设计音色。

@It_Is_My_Duty ♥ 15 · 💬 0

开源模型里，我自动化生产上实测IndexTTS 2最佳，对比过CosyVoice, Qwen3TTS, SparkTTS, FishTTS, MaskGCT, XTTS , 最后还是IndexTTS最稳生产可用，以下是简单对比
